Real Estate + Property Management + Interior Design

Dominique Duncan-Nelson

Find Your Home. Transform Your Space.

Real Estate & Interior Design,
Under One Roof

From finding your next home to shaping how it feels to live in it, Dominique guides you through every step throughout the San Fernando Valley.

Dominique brings together two things that are usually kept separate, buying or selling a home, and designing the life that happens inside it. Whether you are searching for your first house, listing your current one, managing a property, or reimagining a space you already love, she brings the same eye for detail and care to every project.
